question: Who among the following musicians received the Padma Bhushan Award 2022 for his contributions in the field of art?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashid Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rashid Khan** was honored with the Padma Bhushan Award in 2022 for his significant contributions to the field of art.
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
 
• Rashid Khan is a renowned Indian classical musician and vocalist of the Rampur-Sahaswan gharana.
 
• His contributions have significantly enriched Indian classical music, and he is celebrated for his unique style and mastery over the art form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Padma Awards were instituted in the year 1954 and are announced every year on Republic Day.
 
• They are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (for distinguished service of high order), and Padma Shri (for distinguished service in any field).
 
• Rashid Khan has also been awarded the Padma Shri in 2006 and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2006.
 
• He has performed at various prestigious music festivals and has a significant following in India and abroad.
